options.opb: It is usually of juvenile appearance.
options.opc: It is not related to obesity.

analysis: Type II diabetes mellitus is characterized by insulin resistance and is often associated with obesity. It typically occurs in adults, although it can appear in younger individuals, especially with rising obesity rates. Unlike Type I diabetes, it is not commonly associated with ketoacidosis and is not juvenile in onset. Therefore, it is considered insulin-independent, as the body still produces insulin but cannot use it effectively.
